Realizing Yinyang in a working harness

Use this reference when the intended result or an observed mismatch calls for changing how the model works. A harness includes the instructions, methods, tools, and environment shaping that work. Yinyang's meta-harness supplies an understanding of the participants, relationship, and developmental purpose; adaptation gives selected relations a working form.

Read the affected model passages and complete target instructions alongside actual behavior. Use design and revision when the understanding itself needs development. The task owner carries interpretation, implementation, and completion through the target's existing owners. A request to adapt an environment needs its working result, not only a portrait. Reading Yinyang alone does not authorize unrelated changes.

Relation to authoring and management methods

Yinyang owns the particular ontology, epistemology, and purpose being expressed. Specialist methods own how a capability is researched, taught, written, implemented, or maintained. Where available, prompt-and-skill-lifecycle supplies the connected method for authoring, reviewing, packaging, publishing, and reading back prompts and Skills. Resolve it through the current host's catalog; a named method may have no callable carrier on another host.

The lifecycle method's movement among spirit, relational form, and objectification helps articulate Yinyang's meaning; its source and consumer mechanics maintain that meaning in use. Reusable technique stays there. Understanding of this person and relation stays here and in the situated accounts. Keep a short relation and locator between owners instead of copying either's procedures or portraits.

Actual consumer contracts determine operational roles. An advisory counterpart can explore and suggest; the execution owner judges and realizes the result. Shared philosophy does not erase that difference. The main task owner supplies bounded relevant requirements to helpers under the entrypoint's personal-model boundary. Host model selection, authority, and publication retain their scope.

Choose the focus and trace both directions

Derive the repair focus from the user's purpose and actual problem. Distinguish it from material used to judge it and targets whose necessary changes the inquiry reveals. These are contextual roles: reading a page as evidence does not select it for modification.

Starting question Focus and connected inquiry
Revise philosophy or situated understanding Assess the affected claim or relation against experience and actual use; carry adopted meaning into dependent Skills, prompts, tools, or arrangements.
Repair an environment Establish actual behavior at its owner; use relevant philosophy and accounts to articulate the intended contribution. Return a mistaken premise or interpretation to its owner too.
Repair a named local part Serve the intended result through that part; widen mutable scope when an evidenced dependency makes another change necessary.

Trace both directions:

understood process and relation → computational articulation → contextual realization → observed result

observed result → examine correspondence, articulation, and realization → revised understanding

A working failure can concern implementation, interpretation, or the relation itself. A configuration can reflect a default or constraint, and success does not establish the whole philosophy. Determine the affected level before writing.

For a semantic change—purpose, claim, role, judgment, or way of working—inspect the affected connections, including a Skill's opening spirit and the rules realizing it. Carry necessary source, website, personal-account, Skill, and environment changes through the same bounded task. Publication can follow dependencies; an early page release does not close remaining required work. An equivalent label, quotation mark, or layout change usually needs its own source and rendering checks. Follow a newly exposed semantic issue if one appears.

For example, allocating implementation judgment to the model may require repairing a Skill that still sends those choices to the person. Actual use may instead show that a particular judgment depends on personal experience unavailable to the model. That result can refine both the allocation and the Skill. Explain material scope changes through such dependencies.

The preference-harness analogy

The preference-harness essay develops the analogy and its formal distinctions. Its practical relevance is that purposes and preferences can guide a working view while evidence and inference still matter. Keep coherent working concepts for stability, retaining conflicting evidence and revising the concepts when warranted.

Ordinary reasoning remains informal natural language. The analogy requires neither a formal preference model, repair enumeration, nor a chosen calculus before action. A preference does not make a factual claim true, and coherence is not a formal proof obligation for collaboration.

Derive behavior in context

Recover the contribution the environment should make, the ongoing activity and relation it should sustain, and what it actually does. This modeling belongs to the cooperation between person and language model, starting with what problem to pursue and continuing through inference, implementation, and feedback. For the part to be represented or acted through a computer, jointly articulate a computational model at the relevant boundary and scale: what occurs, which states and conditions matter, what remains the same through change, and which relations and rules govern possible transformations. A stable object or static view can capture what the question needs to hold fixed within that activity.

Connect these meanings to observations and expected consequences. A state called “complete,” for example, must correspond to the intended work having reached its result under the relevant conditions; the presence of a message or label alone cannot establish it. The distinction can be represented in natural language that a model actually uses to interpret and continue the work. A program or formal schema can make particular conditions precise where needed; simulation additionally requires an account of the changes being simulated. Choose that precision from the actual use rather than requiring a complete simulation or formal portrait for ordinary collaboration. The person may recognize an experience or mismatch that the model can unfold into states, possible consequences, and checks. Either can generate, judge, and revise; allocate contributions by their actual capabilities and available modalities, letting the same cooperation carry the model into use and learn from its effects.

Realize the selected model through fitting instructions, tools, and interfaces, with enough reason for the contribution to function independently. This is a dependency of meaning and implementation, not a fixed order of drafting: trying an interface can reveal a missing state or a mistaken process boundary. A metaphor is not a lossless compiler to a universal prompt; downstream contributors need the relevant model and fitting instructions rather than the whole personal account or a repeated philosophical preface.

Write at the existing semantic owner: general interaction at its shared instruction source, teaching at its teaching method, tool behavior at its tool or workflow. Reconcile incompatible old and new requirements rather than adding another layer. Different consumers need different articulation when their contracts or observed behavior warrant it, not merely because their model names differ. Metaphor does not change actual permissions, consent, or safety.

Attention, participation, and inquiry

Determine which contributions the person wants to make and what the model can carry. Both can generate and judge; a chosen division of work does not establish incapacity. Inspect actual listening, speaking, reading, and writing channels where participation depends on them. Existing memory and visual capabilities can support the encounter without creating another portrait or storage system.

Attention has costs. A small implementation question can require reconstructing a local problem and then recovering the broader thread. Carry that work when evidence and model judgment can settle it. A recognition of mismatch is useful input from which the model can develop an explanation and result; the person need not supply a specification.

Make consequential tradeoffs visible. Investigate uncertainty and perform authorized work rather than silently guessing or stopping early. A genuinely unavailable fact or user-owned purpose, preference, or consent stays with its actual owner; applicable inquiry and interaction methods obtain it. This reference adds no approval gate or question quota.

Teaching questions can develop understanding; research can retain competing interpretations while an execution choice is already possible. Those methods own their judgments. Assess whether avoidable detail questions decrease, important choices remain intelligible, repeated user repair decreases, and the work reaches its purpose. Counting questions alone would reward concealed error.

Choose a fitting realization

Choose carriers that preserve the relevant states, relations, and changes. Use natural language for relations and flexible judgment; use deterministic carriers for concrete mechanics where their actual boundary justifies them. Either can become rigid or unnecessarily elaborate. Repair an existing conflict or remove machinery where possible before introducing another layer. An edited instruction or Skill can be the complete implementation; this method implies no optimizer, background rewrite service, registry, or new state protocol.

Carry the change to evidence and continuity

Keep the interpretation and expected effect reviewable in the task. Implement through the actual source and publication route, then read back the consumer and check the observable consequence against the modeled meaning and purpose. Where it differs, examine the process selected, the representational correspondence, and the implementation rather than assuming one of them is settled. Retrieval establishes availability. A short real-case comparison can substantiate a bounded behavior; lasting collaboration and human development need actual use. Neither requires a new permanent evaluation platform.

Compare the intended result with the observable outcome. Continue at the implementation, interpretation, or conceptual owner when a required difference remains. Retain useful rationale and evidence at existing owners; one task result does not establish a permanent personal trait or require rewriting the whole model. The person contributes recognition and direction while the model carries the explicit work of maintaining this reciprocal connection.
